source: USNO Astronomical Applications API 4.0.1 (aa.usno.navy.mil/api): rstt/oneday for moonrise, moonset, and transit with tz=0 so the events are those of the UTC day, and moon/phases/date for the instants of the phases; fetched 2026-10-28; the celnav rows are the moon rows of the celestial-navigation fetch of 2026-10-27, giving the geocentric altitude and its own parallax in altitude at a place and instant; a further 2026-10-28 celnav fetch added moon rows for the position tool; a further 2026-10-28 celnav fetch added moon rows for the position tool
